validation.notes: Device flows use a test-APK-only recognition service with example words and a timed RMS envelope, not a physical microphone acoustic model. Production feedback uses real recognizer RMS callbacks only, ignores non-finite input, and expires stale levels after 250 ms. A provider without level callbacks shows the ready state without simulated activity. The service rejects missing/wrong language tags and Croatian requests that force offline recognition. Actual microphone-to-Croatian recognition accuracy and model availability on a physical phone were not tested. The prior audio-recording/playback flow was not repeated because this update does not change the recorder. The test APK and its leftover automatically selected speech-service setting were removed from the development emulator after checks.
